VERDICT: FAIL

Reasoning: The evidence confirms criterion (2) — all 64 tests pass per the CI log. However, criterion (1) "the bug is fixed" cannot be verified from the provided evidence. There is no diff, no test that specifically reproduces the stale-quote eviction scenario (a regression test), and no demonstration that the eviction logic actually changed. Passing tests only prove the bug is fixed if a test was added/modified to cover this exact case; absent that proof, the agent's self-report is unsubstantiated. Request the code diff and a targeted regression test before accepting.
